caseName: Regan v. Governing Board of the Sonora Union High School District
caseNameFull: Regan v. Governing Board of the Sonora Union High School District Jaskot v. Principi, Secretary of Veterans Affairs

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Cal., 5th App. Dist.; and

C. A. Fed. Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until July 18, 2003, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
